Definition: Unique identifier for a given aliquot.
A brief textual description of the analytical test being performed on an aliquot.
An identifier assigned by the sample database combining the three character installation code and the sample id to create a cross-instance unique identifier for a given sample.
The location of a recognized colony from which a sample was collected.
Generalized geographic area associated with a colony's location used for grouping nearby colonies.
Common term name for a species.
The scientific name of a specimen in binomial nomenclature.
Geographical position system coordinates for latitude (various formats).
Geographical position system coordinates for longitude (various formats).
A convenience identifier of the year a sample was collected in [%Y] format.
Chemical name of the analyte being measured.
Detection limit of the analytical method used. NAN if [detected] is true.
Measured value of the analyte. NAN if [detected] is FALSE.
Whether or not the analyte was detected by the analytical method.
Measurement units of [value], [dl], and [statvals] as determined by the analytical method.
Grouping variable for the analyte class.
If [detected] the calculated [value] of the measurement, otherwise the detection limit [dl].
